title: 高松宮記念の後に・悪夢のバッティング

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! This is a farewell run dedicated to my domestic fans. I bid you adieu!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus is a remarkable runner as well, but even she's overwhelmed by Seeking the Pearl's display of raw speed.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Were you always this fast? It's like you transformed into your final form or something!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you're not a hero?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Non, non! I'm no hero.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I wasn't always able to run this fast… I have a major setback to thank for this speed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm just an Umamusume who's now fast enough to hold my own against a hero.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In other words…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Anyone can become a hero." That's the message I wish to spread across the world.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Anyone can be a hero…"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hero or not, Seeking the Pearl is definitely nailing that cool factor.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer? No complaints about my speed, right?
choice_data_list: None at all! You've really got a chance to win!
None at all! You've really got a chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A chance to win, sure… But it's still not a very big chance.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm up against the world. It's not going to be easy. But if everything goes well—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Hey! Did you hear?! It's breaking news!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: I did! They're doing a press conference about it now. Quick, let's find a TV and tune in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several TV reporters rush past us in a hurry.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What's going on, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In any case, we decide to check what's on TV as well.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, y'all! It's me, Taiki Shuttle! I've decided that after runnin' in the Yasuda Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go take on a G1 abroad! And the race I'm gonna run in is…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The Prix Jacques Le Marois over yonder in France! It's a mighty big race!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm aimin' to be the first Tracen Uma to win an international G1!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Unbelievable! Did she just say what I think she did?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We both find ourselves frozen in place. This astonishing announcement has thrown a huge wrench into our plans.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I guess I shouldn't be too surprised…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a moment, Seeking the Pearl finds her calm again.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: She did say at the end of last year that she wanted to run a G1 race abroad, and that her best distance is the mile…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's pretty obvious she'd go for the Prix Jacques Le Marois.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And while it does make a lot of sense, I'm not sure how should we take this news.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well, there's one thing I can say for sure.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I can't beat Taiki Shuttle, there's no way I can win the Prix Jacques Le Marois.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I can't just rely on good luck. Can I really hold my own against Taiki in a mile race right now?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I won't be able to move on until I know the answer to that for sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she's seeking to level up and prove she can go toe-to-toe with Taiki Shuttle, then that must mean…
choice_data_list: Pearl… Are you thinking about running in the Yasuda Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I am. I want to race against Taiki there and see how my running fares against her.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That will be the final test. Is that all right with you? I know it'll make our schedule a little tight, but still.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We absolutely cannot let Seeking the Pearl's international tour end in failure, which means we must ascertain her mettle before we move on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to run in the Yasuda Kinen to compare Seeking the Pearl and Taiki Shuttle's strength.
